summary.text:
We need answer only one st code block. Need fix behavior. We need reason from requirements and formal properties. Current state machine fails sequence tests. Need understand expected sequencing, especially edge/latch semantics. Let's analyze deeply.

We have production line with continuous products potentially? Tests likely feed one unit sequence. Need outputs exact per cycle. Properties impose temporal formulas. Need implement state machine matching given LTL and sequence tests. Need infer desired behavior from requirements/formulas.

Let's restate:

Inputs Mode bool, buttons, five sensors SensorFeed/Wash/Weight/Firing/Output, completion signals washComplete, weightComplete, firingComplete, weight.

Outputs MotorForward, MotorReverse, kick, CompletionLight, firingTemp.

Manual handled: forward iff Mode false and ForwardButton and not Reverse; reverse iff Mode false and Reverse and not Forward; interlock. Should outputs update immediate every cycle based inputs. S5/S6/S9 support.

Auto mode sequence one product: feed sensor -> forward until wash sensor; at wash stop and wait washComplete, then forward to weight; at weight stop wait weightComplete; decide:
- if weight in [100,200], output firingTemp linear, forward to firing.
- else kick and not forward. What happens to unqualified? "initiates rejection command", no forward/do not release. Could go back to idle? Requirements unclear. Property N10-S11 says if unqualified -> kick AND NOT MotorForward. Next cycles? Could perhaps remain at weight waiting? kick pulse one scan? S3 says reject only on unqualified decision "那一拍", "给出时电机不转". Likely kick one cycle; after kick state returns idle waiting next product? Need infer.

Then firing: stop at SensorFiring wait firingComplete, forward to output; at SensorOutput stop and light on; when SensorOutput false, light off.

The current state machine uses state as station progress. However issues:
- On transition entry detection, in same cycle? N10-S10: "自动入口发现进料立即正转；紧接到达清洗...依次停车". Formula says (Mode and not prev Mode and SensorFeed) -> MotorForward same tick. Then prev(...) and SensorWash -> NOT MotorForward same tick. So when sensor Wash true while in traveling-to-wash, stop immediately. Good.
- washComplete at same cycle after clean: if previous cycle SensorWash true and current washComplete -> MotorForward. State transition likely okay.
- N10-S14 cleaning complete after arriving Wash, next cycle not SensorWeight -> forward.
- at weight complete qualified set temp and forward immediately, as formula N10-S11.
- at SensorOutput, stop and light same tick per S13.

Current state machine may fail because state transitions not align with arbitrary repeated sensors, perhaps completion signals not held? Need analyze test "h06-28", "h06-30" sequence behavior mismatch check MotorForward. Need infer exact timing from failing 6 tests. Could inspect files? Workspace read-only? We can list repo maybe tests hidden? We are in build directory. Let's explore to see test artifacts maybe useful.
